oneLine: Fast gain staging and loudness decisions without interrupting the session.
shortDescription: A free metering utility for gain staging, LUFS, true peak, phase, width, balance, and rapid level checks.
longDescription: Move from input trim to delivery confidence in one focused utility. Precision gain control, LUFS and true-peak metering, phase tools, stereo checks, channel solo, presets, and instant A/B comparison keep routine level decisions visible and fast. Zero-latency processing and a resizable interface make it equally useful while tracking, mixing, and preparing a master.
